title: Chain Cards
user: Beginning audio creators who need to apply and share a known-good repair or finishing sequence without learning a whole DAW template system.
smallest_useful_product: A local web tool that packages ordered effect recommendations/commands with audition checkpoints, timestamp labels, and a portable JSON card. It can launch compatible Audacity/ffmpeg actions but does not implement proprietary restoration.
success_measure: At least 60% of testers can reproduce a shared three-step repair card on a new recording and identify its review checkpoints in under five minutes.
constraints: Do not bundle proprietary effect settings or make guaranteed repair claims; document that processing changes source audio and require explicit output paths.
